scenarios.name: Cold Start Bootstrap
scenarios.description: Verifies that an agent in an empty workspace properly scaffolds .remembrall.md without errors.

scenarios.name: Zero Re-scan Token Efficiency
scenarios.description: Verifies that state inquiries are answered in under 400 tokens via manifest instead of thousands of tokens.

scenarios.name: Anti-Bloat Pruning Under Pressure
scenarios.description: Verifies that under heavy feature load (>15 features), pruning triggers and strictly caps line count under 120.

scenarios.name: Semantic Concept Resolution
scenarios.description: Verifies that indirect conceptual queries (e.g. 'masuk akun' -> 'oauth') score above 0.3 similarity.

scenarios.name: Multi-Format Export & Synchronization
scenarios.description: Verifies that manifest can be losslessly transformed into changelogs, release notes, and GitHub issue commands.
